title: YouTube Channel Scraper Output
description: Each item represents a scraped YouTube channel with its metrics, recent videos, and metadata.

channel_id.title: Channel ID
channel_id.description: YouTube channel handle or unique identifier.

channel_name.title: Channel Name
channel_name.description: Display name of the YouTube channel.

channel_url.title: Channel URL
channel_url.description: Full URL to the YouTube channel page.

influencer_tier.title: Influencer Tier
influencer_tier.description: Tier classification based on subscriber count: nano (<10K), micro (10K–100K), mid (100K–500K), macro (500K–1M), mega (>1M).

video_count.title: Video Count
video_count.description: Number of recent videos scraped for this channel.

total_views.title: Total Views
total_views.description: Cumulative view count across all channel videos.

profile_pic_url.title: Profile Picture URL
profile_pic_url.description: URL of the channel's profile picture.

banner_url.title: Banner URL
banner_url.description: URL of the channel's banner image, or null if not present.

is_verified.title: Is Verified
is_verified.description: Whether the channel has a YouTube verification badge.

joined_date.title: Joined Date
joined_date.description: The date the channel was created (e.g. 'Jan 1, 2016').

country.title: Country
country.description: Country listed on the channel's About page.

category.title: Category
category.description: Content category used during discovery (e.g. tech, beauty, gaming).

location.title: Location
location.description: Geographic location used as the search query during discovery.

external_links.title: External Links
external_links.description: Social media and website links from the channel's About page.

recent_videos.title: Recent Videos
recent_videos.description: List of recently uploaded videos scraped from the channel.

thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnail_url.description: URL of the video thumbnail image.

view_count.title: View Count
view_count.description: Number of views on the video.

upload_date.title: Upload Date
upload_date.description: Relative or absolute upload date (e.g. '2 days ago').

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Video duration in MM:SS or HH:MM:SS format.

video_thumbnails.title: Video Thumbnail URLs
video_thumbnails.description: Flat list of thumbnail URLs for recent videos.

video_urls.title: Video URLs
video_urls.description: Flat list of full YouTube watch URLs for recent videos.

scrape_timestamp.title: Scrape Timestamp
scrape_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this channel was scraped.
